Method of Attack: Unquoted Search Path or Element (CWE-428) vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution or password hash capture via crafted URI schemes
Embedding malicious iframes in websites that use the teamviewer10: URI scheme to launch TeamViewer and connect to attacker SMB shares
NTLM authentication relay or hash capture via SMB share connection initiated by victim machine
Discoverer: Jeffrey Hofmann, security engineer at Praetorian
Impacted Systems: Windows PCs running TeamViewer versions 8 through 15
Attack Vector: Malicious iframe embedded in websites using crafted teamviewer URI schemes
SMB protocol connection to attacker-controlled server
